name: Sustainable Shopping
line: About how a city buys things.
deck: The hardest kind of campaign, because it argues with a habit rather than a policy. Nobody signs a bill about their own shopping.

holes.what: No date, no demand and no audience on record. A campaign about buying has to have asked somebody to buy differently, and we cannot say who.
holes.unlocks: Who it spoke to, and what it asked them to do instead.

holes.what: Green the Map sells sustainable goods and is named on our homepage as NOT a Swechha programme. Whether this campaign is connected to it is unstated, and it is the first thing a reader will assume.
holes.unlocks: One line either way. An assumption we leave standing is worse than a gap we name.
